title: 第3章 见蚁后第4章 招新兵第5章 练兵
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
第二天一大早，孙云就被传令蚁叫起来，带到蚁军团部。看着比自己大几圈的蚁团长，直接就懵圈了，这是东窗事发了？
完蛋了，私扣战利品是要被处死的，看着面前威武的蚁团长，却怎么也找不到反抗的勇气。
“你叫什么名字？”蚁团长问！
“报告团长，孙云！”孙云老实道！
“恩，很好！”蚁团长疑惑的看着孙云。
因为，对于蚂蚁来说，这名字确实古怪复杂了点。蚂蚁大多叫个爪子、红头、小草、小树啊等等这些简单的名字，甚至很多蚂蚁还是重名。
而这孙云，也太特别了点，不过蚁团长也没去追究，毕竟叫什么名是蚁的自由！
“听说你还是个小队长，以你的体型不应该吖？”蚁团长疑惑道！
现在的孙云，已经超过了百蚁中队长的体型，难道不得领导赏识？
“报告团长，我是侦察九分队长。”孙云激动道。他可是第一次见到团长，心里有些小兴奋。
“小子，你走运了，蚁后要见你！”
蚁团长微笑道。
侦察兵？蚁团长确定了自己的猜测，侦察兵又危险，又辛苦，而且经常脱离大部队。这小子肯定是得罪了领导，才被分配侦察兵做个小队长，显然是受到排斥了。
“团长，这?”孙云疑惑不解！
“你知道你收获的蜈蚣是什么吗？准异兽，跟我来吧！”蚁团长激动的在前边走着，极力掩饰着自己的失态！准异兽啊，多么强大的存在，赏我一块肉，我有足够的信心再大一圈。蚁团长心想！
“团长，准异兽是什么？”孙云急忙跟上疑惑的问！像孙云这级别是没资格知道这些秘闻的，自然他也没听说过！
“准异兽是接近异兽的强大存在，别说我们蚁族很难遇到，就算遇到也是我们不敢挑战的。毕竟要损失我们整个战斗兵蚁军团，也不敢说能稳胜。”蚁团长耐心道！必竟能见到蚁后，此蚁以后前途无量啊。
“这么强的吗？”
孙云忍不住惊叹不已！
整个战斗兵蚁，几万最强壮的蚂蚁啊，说是代表整个族群的战斗力也不为过！孙云本来有点小得意的，可听到这准异兽，感觉自己还是太渺小了。

“那是，这准异兽……”
蚁团长看孙云这么惊讶，又道出一些秘闻！愿来，准异兽的肉吃了可以强大身体，是不可多得的奇肉。
据说，蚁后曾侥幸得到过一个异兽螳螂，才成就了这么大的蚁群。蚁后的四大心腹，也是得了蚁后的好处，才成长的那么强大的！
“嗯嗯，原来如此……”
孙云一边与蚁团长聊天，一边向蚁穴深处走。
在走过几道弯，孙云和蚁团长，终于来到了巨大的宫殿。但孙云越走越心惊，因为两边警卫队的体型，都是快要接近蚁团长的存在。
再步入主殿更惊讶，两边我有近三十个像蚁团长一样强大的蚂蚁。要知道，蚁群据说才六个蚁团长，分别跟着绿头护卫将军、紫头守卫将军、红头战斗将军，每军团各有两个团长。这里有这么强大的护卫，可见蚁后的护卫队实力，不下于蚁军的高层力量。
“这？”
正前方有六只护卫更强大，竟然比孙云两个还要大，这也太壮了。孙云再在抬头，直接被惊呆住了，竟然有三只巨大的蚂蚁。
两只贴身护卫，非常雄壮威武，比孙云大十倍也不止。而蚁后就更巨大了，就像一栋小楼，让孙云产生渺小的感觉。
更惊人的是，蚁后后面面有一只巨大的雄蚁卖力的做着最原始的运动。看后面还有几只排队的，这一时半会，肯定没的停了。
蚁团长赶快拉着发呆的孙云大喊道:“毛爪参见蚁后！”孙云被蚁团长一拉，急忙跟着蚁团长跪下。
“啊，起……起来回话！”蚁杏眼迷离道。
content_en:
Early the next morning, Sun Yun was summoned by the messenger ants and brought to the ant army headquarters. Looking at the leader of the ants who were several times older than him, he was immediately confused. Is this a secret incident?
It's over. Anyone who seizes the loot privately will be punished by death. Looking at the mighty ant leader in front of him, he can't find the courage to resist.
"What's your name?" asked the ant leader!
"Report to the captain, Sun Yun!" Sun Yun said honestly!
"Well, very good!" Captain Yi looked at Sun Yun doubtfully.
Because, for ants, this name is indeed a bit weird and complicated. Most ants are called by simple names such as claw, red head, grass, small tree, etc. Many ants even have the same name.
And this Sun Yun is too special, but the leader of the ants did not pursue it. After all, the name is the freedom of the ants!
"I heard that you are still a squad leader. With your size, shouldn't you be?" Captain Ant asked in confusion!
Now that Sun Yun has surpassed the size of the leader of the Hundred Ant Squadron, shouldn't he be appreciated by the leader?
"Report to the captain, I am the captain of the ninth reconnaissance team." Sun Yun said excitedly. This was the first time he saw the group leader, and he felt a little excited.
"Boy, you're in luck, the Queen Ant wants to see you!"
The ant leader smiled.
Scout? Captain Ant confirmed his guess. Scouts are dangerous and hard-working, and they often break away from the main force. This kid must have offended the leader, so he was assigned to be a scout as a squad leader. He was obviously ostracized.
"Captain, this?" Sun Yun was puzzled!
"Do you know what centipedes you harvested? Quasi-exotic beasts, come with me!" The ant captain walked forward excitedly, trying his best to hide his gaffe! A quasi-exotic beast, what a powerful existence. Give me a piece of meat. I have enough confidence to grow bigger. The ant leader thought to himself!
"Captain, what is the quasi-exotic beast?" Sun Yun hurriedly followed up and asked in confusion! Someone at Sun Yun's level is not qualified to know these secrets, so naturally he has never heard of them!
"Quasi-alien beasts are powerful beings that are close to alien beasts. Not to mention that it is difficult for us ants to encounter them. Even if we encounter them, we dare not challenge them. After all, if we lose our entire fighting soldier ant army, we can't say that we can win surely." The ant leader said patiently! I will definitely be able to see the queen ant. This ant will have a bright future in the future.
"Is he so strong?"
Sun Yun couldn't help but be amazed!
The entire fighting soldier ants, tens of thousands of the strongest ants, it is not an exaggeration to say that they represent the fighting power of the entire group! Sun Yun was a little proud at first, but after hearing this quasi-exotic beast, he still felt too small.
"That's it, this quasi-exotic beast..."
Captain Yi saw Sun Yun being so surprised and revealed some secrets! Hopefully, eating the meat of quasi-exotic beasts can strengthen your body. It is a rare and rare meat.
It is said that the queen ant was lucky enough to get a mantis, a strange animal, and that was how she built such a large ant colony. The four closest confidants of the Queen Ant also grew up so powerful because of the Queen Ant's benefits!
"Yeah, that's it..."
Sun Yun walked deeper into the ant nest while chatting with the ant leader.
After walking through several twists and turns, Sun Yun and Captain Yi finally arrived at the huge palace. But Sun Yun became more and more frightened as he walked, because the size of the guards on both sides was almost close to that of the ant captain.
I was even more surprised when I entered the main hall. On both sides, there were nearly thirty ants as powerful as the ant leaders. You know, the ant colony is said to have only six ant captains, followed by the green-headed guard general, the purple-headed guard general, and the red-headed battle general. Each legion has two captains. There are such powerful guards here, which shows that the strength of the ant queen's guard team is no less than the high-level strength of the ant army.
"This?"
There are six more powerful guards directly in front, even bigger than the two Sun Yun, which is too strong. Sun Yun looked up again and was stunned to see three huge ants.
The two personal guards were very majestic and mighty, more than ten times bigger than Sun Yun. The queen ant was even bigger, like a small building, which made Sun Yun feel insignificant.feeling.
What is even more astonishing is that behind the queen ant there is a huge male ant doing the most primitive movements. Seeing that there are still a few people queuing up at the back, they will definitely stop at this moment.
The ant leader quickly pulled Sun Yun, who was in a daze, and shouted: "The hairy claws meet the queen ant!" Sun Yun was pulled by the ant leader and hurriedly followed the ant leader to kneel down.
"Ah, get up...get up and say something back!" Yan said with blurred eyes.
